# EagleAir HVAC

> EagleAir is a locally owned, Florida-registered HVAC contractor in Sarasota, Florida, providing 24/7 residential and commercial air conditioning, heating and ventilation service across Sarasota, Manatee and Charlotte counties.

## Services

- [Air Conditioning](https://www.eagleair-hvac.com/air-conditioning.html): AC repair, replacement and tune-ups for residential and commercial systems, including refrigerant leaks, compressor and capacitor failure, and condensate drain clogs.
- [Emergency Repair](https://www.eagleair-hvac.com/emergency-repair.html): 24/7 emergency HVAC repair, all brands and models, for no-cool and no-heat calls including after-hours, weekends and holidays.
- [Installation](https://www.eagleair-hvac.com/installation.html): Full HVAC system installation — load calculation, equipment selection, ductwork and warrantied professional install for replacements and new construction.
- [Maintenance](https://www.eagleair-hvac.com/maintenance.html): Scheduled maintenance plans covering coil cleaning, drain-line flushing, refrigerant check and electrical inspection to keep systems running through Florida's year-round cooling season.
- [Heating](https://www.eagleair-hvac.com/heating.html): Heat pump and furnace repair and installation for Florida's short heating season, including auxiliary heat strip diagnosis.
- [Ventilation & Indoor Air Quality](https://www.eagleair-hvac.com/ventilation.html): Ductwork, air handlers and ERV systems for humidity control and indoor air quality in a hot-humid climate.
- [Mini-Split Systems](https://www.eagleair-hvac.com/mini-split.html): Ductless mini-split installation for room-by-room control — garages, additions, lanais and older homes without ductwork.

## Service Areas

- [Sarasota (main)](https://www.eagleair-hvac.com/): Home base. Full HVAC service across the city of Sarasota and Sarasota County.
- [Bradenton](https://www.eagleair-hvac.com/bradenton.html) · [Palmetto](https://www.eagleair-hvac.com/palmetto.html) · [Lakewood Ranch](https://www.eagleair-hvac.com/lakewood-ranch.html): Manatee County service areas.
- [Longboat Key](https://www.eagleair-hvac.com/longboat-key.html) · [Siesta Key](https://www.eagleair-hvac.com/siesta-key.html): Barrier-island service areas where salt air shortens condenser life.
- [Osprey](https://www.eagleair-hvac.com/osprey.html) · [Nokomis](https://www.eagleair-hvac.com/nokomis.html) · [Venice](https://www.eagleair-hvac.com/venice.html) · [Englewood](https://www.eagleair-hvac.com/englewood.html) · [North Port](https://www.eagleair-hvac.com/north-port.html): South Sarasota County service areas.
- [Port Charlotte](https://www.eagleair-hvac.com/port-charlotte.html) · [Punta Gorda](https://www.eagleair-hvac.com/punta-gorda.html) · [Rotonda West](https://www.eagleair-hvac.com/rotonda-west.html) · [Deep Creek](https://www.eagleair-hvac.com/deep-creek.html) · [Murdock](https://www.eagleair-hvac.com/murdock.html): Charlotte County service areas.
